descricao: Exemplo público do formato do gabarito: perguntas do conjunto de teste sem nomes de fornecedores, compradores ou itens. Os gabaritos completos (gabarito.json e gabarito_teste.json) têm dados da empresa e ficam fora do Git.

perguntas.pergunta: Quantas ordens de compra foram criadas em 2025?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM po_headers_all pha WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

perguntas.pergunta: Quantas ordens de compra estão fechadas?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM po_headers_all pha WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND pha.document_status = 'CLOSED'

perguntas.pergunta: Quantas ordens de compra estão em aprovação?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM po_headers_all pha WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND pha.document_status = 'PENDING APPROVAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM po_headers_all pha WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'BLANKET'

perguntas.pergunta: Quantas ordens de compra foram criadas no primeiro semestre de 2026?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM po_headers_all pha WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2026-07-01'

perguntas.pergunta: Quantas ordens de compra estão rejeitadas ou incompletas, entre as criadas em 2026?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM po_headers_all pha WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND pha.document_status IN ('REJECTED','INCOMPLETE') AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01'

perguntas.pergunta: Quais as 5 ordens de compra de maior valor em 2026?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT pha.segment1 AS numero_ordem, SUM(CASE WHEN pla.order_type_lookup_code = 'AMOUNT' THEN pla.amount ELSE pla.quantity * pla.unit_price END) AS valor_total FROM po_headers_all pha JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND NVL(pha.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.document_status NOT IN ('INCOMPLETE','REJECTED','CANCELED') AND NVL(pla.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY pha.segment1 ORDER BY valor_total DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

perguntas.pergunta: Quais as 5 categorias com mais itens distintos comprados em 2026?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT ect.category_name AS categoria, COUNT(DISTINCT pla.item_id) AS qtd_itens FROM po_headers_all pha JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id JOIN egp_categories_tl ect ON ect.category_id = pla.category_id AND ect.language = 'PTB' WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND NVL(pha.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.document_status NOT IN ('INCOMPLETE','REJECTED','CANCELED') AND NVL(pla.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY ect.category_name ORDER BY qtd_itens DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

perguntas.pergunta: Qual a unidade de medida mais frequente nas linhas das ordens de compra criadas em 2026?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT pla.uom_code AS unidade FROM po_headers_all pha JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY pla.uom_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

perguntas.pergunta: Quais os 3 fornecedores com mais ordens de compra emitidas em 2026?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT psv.vendor_name AS fornecedor, COUNT(*) AS qtd_ordens FROM po_headers_all pha JOIN poz_suppliers_v psv ON psv.vendor_id = pha.vendor_id WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY psv.vendor_name ORDER BY qtd_ordens DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

perguntas.pergunta: Qual o valor total comprado em cada mês de 2026 (mês no formato AAAA-MM)?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT TO_CHAR(pha.creation_date,'YYYY-MM') AS mes, SUM(CASE WHEN pla.order_type_lookup_code = 'AMOUNT' THEN pla.amount ELSE pla.quantity * pla.unit_price END) AS valor_total FROM po_headers_all pha JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND NVL(pha.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.document_status NOT IN ('INCOMPLETE','REJECTED','CANCELED') AND NVL(pla.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(pha.creation_date,'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY mes

perguntas.pergunta: Qual o valor médio por ordem de compra em 2026?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT AVG(v.valor_ordem) AS valor_medio FROM (SELECT pha.po_header_id, pha.agent_id, SUM(CASE WHEN pla.order_type_lookup_code = 'AMOUNT' THEN pla.amount ELSE pla.quantity * pla.unit_price END) AS valor_ordem FROM po_headers_all pha JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND NVL(pha.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.document_status NOT IN ('INCOMPLETE','REJECTED','CANCELED') AND NVL(pla.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY pha.po_header_id, pha.agent_id) v

perguntas.pergunta: Quais compradores emitiram mais de 20 ordens de compra em 2026?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT ppn.display_name AS comprador, COUNT(*) AS qtd_ordens FROM po_headers_all pha JOIN per_person_names_f ppn ON ppn.person_id = pha.agent_id AND ppn.name_type = 'GLOBAL' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ppn.effective_start_date AND ppn.effective_end_date WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY ppn.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 20 ORDER BY qtd_ordens DESC

perguntas.pergunta: Quantas ordens de compra têm mais de 10 linhas?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM (SELECT pha.po_header_id FROM po_headers_all pha JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' GROUP BY pha.po_header_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10)

perguntas.pergunta: Qual foi o mês de 2026 com maior valor comprado (mês no formato AAAA-MM)?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT TO_CHAR(pha.creation_date,'YYYY-MM') AS mes, SUM(CASE WHEN pla.order_type_lookup_code = 'AMOUNT' THEN pla.amount ELSE pla.quantity * pla.unit_price END) AS valor_total FROM po_headers_all pha JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND NVL(pha.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.document_status NOT IN ('INCOMPLETE','REJECTED','CANCELED') AND NVL(pla.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(pha.creation_date,'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY valor_total DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

perguntas.pergunta: Quantas ordens de compra foram criadas em 2026 em cada status?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT pha.document_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM po_headers_all pha WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY pha.document_status ORDER BY qtd DESC

perguntas.pergunta: Quais os 5 compradores com maior valor médio por ordem de compra em 2026?
perguntas.sql_referencia: SELECT ppn.display_name AS comprador, AVG(v.valor_ordem) AS valor_medio FROM (SELECT pha.po_header_id, pha.agent_id, SUM(CASE WHEN pla.order_type_lookup_code = 'AMOUNT' THEN pla.amount ELSE pla.quantity * pla.unit_price END) AS valor_ordem FROM po_headers_all pha JOIN po_lines_all pla ON pla.po_header_id = pha.po_header_id WHERE pha.type_lookup_code = 'STANDARD' AND NVL(pha.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.document_status NOT IN ('INCOMPLETE','REJECTED','CANCELED') AND NVL(pla.cancel_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pha.creation_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pha.creation_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY pha.po_header_id, pha.agent_id) v JOIN per_person_names_f ppn ON ppn.person_id = v.agent_id AND ppn.name_type = 'GLOBAL' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN ppn.effective_start_date AND ppn.effective_end_date GROUP BY ppn.display_name ORDER BY valor_medio DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
